requirements.desc: Agent calls support a validated attribution mode whose default preserves ambient behavior and whose no-flow mode performs no flow-context resolution for prompt-cache or metrics.
requirements.note: R1: no-flow policy bypasses ambient cache and metric authority

requirements.desc: A no-flow call skips flow-scoped cache reads, cache writes, cache-hit metrics, success metrics, and failure metrics while preserving provider execution, return text, thrown errors, and cache-decision callbacks.
requirements.note: R2: provider failure preserves foreign bytes and error behavior

requirements.desc: Agent start/end logs for a no-flow call retain the existing log files and payload shape but set spec, sentiPhase, and taskId to null without resolving an ambient flow.
requirements.note: R3: standalone logs keep explicit null flow identity

requirements.desc: createPluginAgentApi delegates resolve and call with existing plugin commandId namespacing and provider/profile configuration precedence, and applies a core-bound attribution mode after plugin-supplied options so the plugin cannot override it.
requirements.note: R4: plugin API delegates resolve and preserves resolution options

requirements.desc: dispatchPluginCommand supplies the standalone plugin context through createPluginAgentApi bound to no-flow attribution, while runFlowCommandHooks retains ambient attribution without plugin-name or workflow-command special cases.
requirements.note: R5: standalone registry dispatch binds no-flow attribution

requirements.desc: Spec-local tests snapshot every seeded foreign specs/*/flow.json file and active-flow .senti/agent-cache file before and after standalone provider success, provider failure, and repeated equivalent calls, and assert byte-identical content.
requirements.note: R6: repeated standalone calls keep every seeded flow and cache byte-identical

requirements.desc: Spec-local tests construct an active managed worktree layout, main repository layouts with one and multiple active flows, and a no-flow repository layout, then assert the R6 byte snapshots remain equal for each layout.
requirements.note: R7: repository-layout matrix never selects foreign flow authority

requirements.desc: Existing core flow agent calls and explicit flow-hook agent calls retain ambient cache attribution and exactly one invocation metric for each provider call; existing cache-hit attribution remains unchanged.
requirements.note: R8: explicit flow hook retains one ambient provider-call attribution
